title: CO<SUP>+</SUP> as a probe of the origin of CO in diffuse interstellar clouds
question: Is thermal cosmic-ray and UV-driven chemistry producing CO in diffuse interstellar molecular gas through the intermediate formation of CO+?

recipe.method: Extract absorption spectra at the continuum peak in each spectral window from standard pipeline-processed products
key_parameters: Channel spacing 244 kHz (0.31 km/s); spectral resolution is twice the channel spacing

recipe.goal: Integrate opacity and derive column densities / limits
recipe.method: Integrate line profiles over fixed velocity intervals; 3-sigma upper limits for non-detections; convert integrated opacity to column density
key_parameters: Integration velocity intervals -14..10 km/s (J1717-3342) and -20..20 km/s (J1744-3116)
N(HCO+) = 1.12e12 cm^-2 x integral tau dv
assumptions: CO+ excitation set by the CMB at 2.73 K

recipe.goal: Derive CO+/HCO+ ratio and X(CO+) limits
recipe.method: Ratio of N(CO+) limits to N(HCO+) and to N(H2) = N(HCO+)/3e-9
assumptions: Standard HCO+ abundance relative to H2 of 3e-9 in diffuse molecular gas

recipe.goal: Test CO+ + H2 as the HCO+ source (analytic balance)
recipe.method: Equate HCO+ formation via CO+ + H2 with HCO+ recombination with electrons and solve for required n(CO+)/n(HCO+) and X(CO+); compare with observed limits
assumptions: Steady state; photodissociation neglected; HCO+ destroyed by thermal-electron recombination

recipe.goal: Model the coupled CO+/HOC+/HCO+ thermal chemistry
recipe.method: Self-consistent atomic/molecular, ionization and thermal equilibrium in gas spheres with column density varied and abundances integrated along the central line of sight; test variants of rates and abundances (baseline, HOC+ isomerization rate, HOC+ formation from CO+ + H2, C+ + H2O channel, X(CH+))
assumptions: Interstellar radiation field (Draine field G0 = 1 elsewhere); HOC+ formation via O + CH3+ ignored as non-thermal

recipe.goal: Derive n(H)/G0 for CO formation from N(CO)/N(HCO+)
recipe.method: Balance CO formation by HCO+ dissociative recombination against CO photodissociation for a uniform slab and solve for n(H)/G0 as a function of E(B-V) for the QSO sight-line sample
key_parameters: A_V = 3.1 E(B-V), E(B-V) from Green et al. 2019, nominal error 0.02 mag
assumptions: Draine radiation field defined as G0 = 1; photodissociation rate 2.43e-10 s^-1 attenuated as exp(-gamma A_V) with gamma = 3.88; line-of-sight averages replace local quantities

score_reason: Project code and final numeric tables are given and the spectral extraction is simple, but pipeline version, calibrators, extraction/limit procedure and the chemical model code are not given.
rediscovery_reason: The observational part (CO+ non-detection limits and column densities) is numeric and rests on a single archive-linked project with simple extraction, although public status is not stated in the paper and the chemical modelling is not reproducible from the text.
